name: Mento Swiss Franc
oneLiner: CHFm is Mento's CDP-backed Swiss franc stablecoin on Celo, minted by borrowers against USDm collateral inside the Mento system.
collateral: Mento CDP debt backed by USDm collateral, with live collateral and debt rows exposed by the Mento reserve dashboard API
pegMechanism: CDP-backed Mento FX stablecoin: borrowers mint CHFm against USDm collateral, while repayment/redemption mechanics and oracle pricing route value back through the Mento system

oracleRisk.summary: CHFm's sole Celo CDP branch values USDm through one Mento SortedOracles CHF/USD report, inverted by FXPriceFeed. OracleAdapter enforces FX market hours, BreakerBox bidirectional mode, and a 360-second report expiry; there is no alternate provider. An invalid or unavailable rate freezes price-dependent operations until the authorized watchdog permanently shuts the branch and pins the last valid price.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento's pinned Celo deployment registry exposes one CHFm Liquity branch. At finalized Celo block 72135701, its live CollateralRegistry returned one collateral, USDm as token 0, and the CHFm TroveManager as manager 0; no additional CHFm collateral branch exists.

branches.label: Mento CHFm / USDm branch
branches.summary: The live CHFm branch uses one Mento SortedOracles CHF/USD report with a 360-second token expiry, a 110% MCR, Stability Pool offset, and active-Trove redistribution. Price-dependent calls freeze on invalid data until watchdog shutdown; there is no alternate oracle provider.

feeds.path: One CHF/USD SortedOracles report -> OracleAdapter market-hours, BreakerBox, and 360-second freshness validation -> FXPriceFeed inversion -> USDm-backed CHFm Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: FXPriceFeed reads rateFeedID 0x0f61BA9c30ef7CaEE7E5CC1F96BFFCb0f52ccD64 through OracleAdapter 0xa472fBBF4b890A54381977ac392BdF82EeC4383a and inverts it. At finalized block 72135701, one report was live, its timestamp was 51 seconds old against a 360-second expiry, trading was bidirectional, and the FX market was open. No alternate provider exists: stale, closed-market, suspended, or invalid data makes price reads revert until watchdog 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 irreversibly shuts the branch, after which FXPriceFeed returns lastValidPrice.

collateralParameters.note: The live SystemParams proxy returned MCR 110%, CCR 135%, SCR 110%, and BCR 10%; TroveManager shutdownTime was zero at finalized Celo block 72135701.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can submit Trove IDs to public batchLiquidateTroves; each active or zombie Trove with ICR below the 110% MCR is liquidated immediately, except that the implementation prevents liquidating the branch's final Trove. The Stability Pool offsets available debt and receives USDm collateral, while uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to active Troves.
branches.backstop: Stability Pool 0xc415cA43aB6Ab246E64559696b8DCAcdd08A39e8 is the first backstop. It held 5,000 CHFm at finalized block 72135701; liquidation logic leaves the configured 1 CHFm minimum untouched. Debt beyond available offsets is redistributed with collateral across active Troves through DefaultPool; the branch graph and pinned implementation expose no separate insurance or reserve absorber.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Residual liquidation debt beyond the Stability Pool is assigned pro rata to active Troves, and the last Trove cannot be liquidated. If branch TCR falls below the 110% SCR, anyone can shut the branch down; the authorized watchdog can also permanently shut it after oracle failure. Shutdown stops new borrowing and interest accrual and enables urgent redemption at the last valid price, burning CHFm for USDm even against the final Trove.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: On 2026-07-15, the verified CHFm StableTokenV3 implementation exposed owner-gated setBurner(address,bool), whose enabled burner can burn(address account,uint256 value) from an arbitrary holder balance, and owner-gated setOperator(address,bool), whose enabled operator can sendToPool(sender,pool,amount) from an arbitrary holder balance. At Celo block 72170200, owner() and the custom proxy owner resolved to the existing 4-of-6 Mento Safe; observed burner and operator contracts used constrained protocol paths, but the Safe can immediately add another burner or operator. The token ABI has no named blacklist, freeze, or pause function. Current Mento terms endpoints and archive discovery did not establish separate transfer restrictions, so the direct owner-mediated holder-intervention surface is classified Possible rather than an immediate blacklist.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: CHFm is minted by Mento's immutable BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts for borrower debt and accrued interest. The token owner and proxy admin, plus the SystemParams ProxyAdmin owner, resolve to the same immediate 4/6 Mento Safe.

controls.label: CHFm BorrowerOperations debt minter
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72082708, CHFm isMinter(0x7Fe90CF5A41473179fCE89Df55bc9afcd1c5c0be) returned true. The contract had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and owner() reverted. Pinned Mento source shows BorrowerOperations mints the borrower's CHFm debt through this immutable deployment.

controls.label: CHFm ActivePool interest minter
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72082708, CHFm isMinter(0x9947CEe121586fC31b0b0a162A40D6516979E7cB) returned true. The contract had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and owner() reverted. Pinned Mento source shows ActivePool mints accrued CHFm interest through this immutable deployment.

controls.label: Mento Safe - CHFm token, minter, and SystemParams admin
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72082708, CHFm owner() and its custom EIP-1967 owner/admin slot both returned this Safe. SystemParams ProxyAdmin 0x68932b8fDd82dA5B0fCe2AcA20A82ea0e11D894A also returned this Safe as owner. The Safe can immediately set token minters and replace token or SystemParams logic. Current state was 4-of-6 with no enabled modules or guard.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Safe - CHFm token, minter, and SystemParams admin

review.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72082708, isMinter was true for immutable BorrowerOperations 0x7Fe90CF5A41473179fCE89Df55bc9afcd1c5c0be and immutable ActivePool 0x9947CEe121586fC31b0b0a162A40D6516979E7cB, and false for legacy Broker 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD. The April 27 migration transaction independently records that revocation and both grants. Token ownership, token upgrades, minter changes, and the upgradeable SystemParams dependency all resolve to the same immediate 4/6 Safe with no modules, guard, or timelock.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: CHFm currently has one tracked Celo contract and no separate cross-chain route in local metadata. The L2BEAT Celo signal is chain infrastructure context, not evidence of a token bridge route for CHFm.

reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Mento's pinned analytics configuration names CHFm as a CDP backed by USDm, and the live reserve endpoint's CHFm trove records USDm as collateral. The static category is exactly one tracked USDm exposure; USDm's underlying basket remains owned by cusd-celo and is not duplicated here.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento CHFm CDP collateral configuration and live reserve dashboard
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: CHFm's sole direct collateral category is USDm; USDm's own reserve composition is reviewed separately on cusd-celo.
